limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.

External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

prohibited_claims: Do not call a screened parcel entitled, acquired, financeable, buildable, or community-supported.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
